# Teach Talent

> Education recruitment agency for teaching assistants, SEN teaching assistants, HLTAs and 1:1 support staff across the East of England (Cambridgeshire, Norfolk, Suffolk, Essex, Hertfordshire, Bedfordshire).

Phone: 01223 000000. Email: hello@teachtalent.co.uk. Office: Office 1, Example House, Hills Road, Cambridge. Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 6pm.
